$description: Pure black surface, white played range, yellow focus; rail and buffered raised for clearer separation.

surface.$description: Player surface: always dark in every theme (video letterbox, control bar).

scrim.$description: Caption/control scrim behind text. Opaque here; apply alpha in CSS only when the measured result still meets 4.5:1.

fg.$description: Icons and text on the player. 21.0:1 on surface, 21.0:1 on scrim.

rail.$description: Seek/volume track rail; 4.17:1 on surface (3:1 UI), played range 5.03:1 against it.

buffered.$description: Buffered range, kept between rail and played; 3.4:1 against played and 3.4:1 against the white thumb (3:1 UI minimum each).

played.$description: Played range; 8.73:1 against rail, 3.4:1 against buffered (3:1 UI minimum).

live.$description: LIVE badge/edge marker fill; 4.22:1 on surface (3:1 UI), white live-fg text on it 4.98:1. Always with the text LIVE.

focus.$description: Focus ring on media controls; 19.56:1 on surface.
